title: So-San

symbol.name: So-San
symbol.meaning: The monk Seosan · ITF pattern 22 of 24

note.p: So-San is the pen name of the great monk Choi Hyong-ung (1520–1604) of the Joseon (Yi) dynasty. The 72 movements stand for his age when, with the help of his pupil Samyeongdang, he organised a corps of monk soldiers, who helped drive back the Japanese pirates that overran most of the Korean peninsula in 1592. You start in close ready stance A facing D: guarding blocks in rear foot stance with vertical punches; knife-hand blocks and punches on the diagonals; twin knife-hand strikes, high side and turning kicks and jumps into X-stance; double fist punches and releases; middle-knuckle upset punches and back fists; a flying front kick; high front blocks with punches; double arc-hand blocks, knife-hand strikes, circular blocks, low kicks and X-knife-hand blocks; jumping spins with guarding blocks; scooping blocks and side kicks from bending ready stance; and a guarding block and high punch to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (72 movements, one technique each). The moves go back and forth through the centre of the + diagram, so the board shows them in order, read down the page in rows; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; BC, BD, AC and AD are diagonals. Finish by bringing the right foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre facing D in close ready stance A.
Slide toward C into a right rear foot stance facing D (left foot forward on its ball). Forearm middle guarding block.
Slip the left foot forward into a left walking stance. Right middle vertical punch.
Slide toward C into a left rear foot stance facing D (right foot forward on its ball). Forearm middle guarding block.
Slip the right foot forward into a right walking stance. Left middle vertical punch.
Turn into a left walking stance facing BC. Right knife-hand high side block.
Turn into a sitting stance facing BD. Left middle punch toward BD, fast after 5.
Turn into a right walking stance facing BD. Left knife-hand high side block.
Turn into a sitting stance facing BD. Right middle punch toward BD, fast after 7.
Move the right foot to C, turning clockwise into a parallel stance facing A. Twin knife-hand horizontal strike.
Right high side piercing kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Without setting the foot down, right high turning kick toward D.
Land the right foot toward D with a jump, into a right X-stance facing BD. Right back fist high side strike toward D, the left fingertips on the right side fist.
Move the left foot to C into a parallel stance facing B. Twin knife-hand horizontal strike.
Left high side piercing kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Without setting the foot down, left high turning kick toward D.
Land the left foot toward D with a jump, into a left X-stance facing AD. Left back fist high side strike toward D, the right fingertips on the left side fist.
Move the left foot to A into a right L-stance facing A (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left double fist low punch.
Put the right palm on the left fist and twist them until the back of the left fist faces down, slipping the left foot forward into a left walking stance (a release).
In the same stance, right high punch.
Move the left foot along the A–B line into a left L-stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right double fist low punch.
Put the left palm on the right fist and twist them until the back of the right fist faces down, slipping the right foot forward into a right walking stance (a release).
In the same stance, left high punch.
Slide toward B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right middle knuckle fist upset punch, the left side fist in front of the right shoulder.
Slip the right foot into a left walking stance facing B. Right back fist front strike.
Slide toward A, turning clockwise, into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Left middle knuckle fist upset punch, the right side fist in front of the left shoulder.
Slip the left foot into a right walking stance facing A. Left back fist front strike.
Move the left foot to D into a right walking ready stance facing C.
Jump: right flying front snap kick toward C.
Land toward C in a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Move the right foot back to D into a left walking stance facing C. Right forearm high front block.
Shift toward C, keeping the walking stance. Left middle punch.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn clockwise into a right walking stance facing D. Left forearm high front block.
Shift toward D, keeping the walking stance. Right middle punch.
Turn into a left walking stance facing BC. Double arc-hand middle block, looking through the hands.
In the same stance, right knife-hand high inward strike toward BC, the left side fist in front of the right shoulder.
Turn into a right walking stance facing D. Left inner forearm circular block toward BD.
In the same stance, right high punch.
Left low front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward D into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
In the same stance, right middle punch, fast after 39.
In the same stance, X-knife-hand rising block.
Turn into a right walking stance facing AC. Double arc-hand middle block, looking through the hands.
In the same stance, left knife-hand high inward strike toward AC, the right side fist in front of the left shoulder.
Turn into a left walking stance facing D. Right inner forearm circular block toward AD.
In the same stance, left high punch.
Right low front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch, fast after 47.
In the same stance, X-knife-hand rising block.
Move the left foot to D, then slide toward D turning counter-clockwise into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Jump toward C, spinning counter-clockwise, landing in a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Slip the left foot forward into a left walking stance facing D. Right knife-hand low block and left inner forearm middle outward block, together.
In the same stance, right high punch, straight on from 52.
Pull the left foot back into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left middle side punch.
Move the right foot to D, then slide toward D turning clockwise into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Jump toward C, spinning clockwise, landing in a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Slip the right foot forward into a right walking stance facing D. Left knife-hand low block and right inner forearm middle outward block, together.
In the same stance, left high punch, straight on from 57.
Pull the right foot back into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right middle side punch.
Move the right foot to the side rear of the left foot, then slide toward C into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right palm scooping block.
Shift toward D, keeping the L-stance. Left middle punch.
Turn clockwise, drawing the right foot up into a left bending ready stance A, side-on to C.
Right high side piercing kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward C into a right walking stance facing C. Left middle punch.
Move the right foot to D into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Move the left foot to the side rear of the right foot, then slide toward D into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left palm scooping block.
Shift toward C, keeping the L-stance. Right middle punch.
Turn counter-clockwise, drawing the left foot up into a right bending ready stance A.
Left high side piercing kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward D into a left walking stance facing D. Right middle punch.
Move the left foot to C into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Slip the right foot forward into a right walking stance. Right high punch, straight on from 71.
